findings.summary: plugin.json and marketplace.json lost their trailing newline at end of file when the version bump was applied, inconsistent with every other file in the repo (including their own prior revision).

findings.rule: coding-standards rule 7 (no dead code) — low confidence: NameStatusRecord/parse_name_status is a general-purpose parser whose own docstring documents C as a possible status, so this may be deliberate defensiveness rather than dead code.
findings.summary: dropped_test_files and dropped_eval_cases both branch on rec.status in ("R", "C"), but the only git invocation that feeds them (diff.name_status, which calls `git diff --name-status -M -z`, no `-C`) can never produce a "C" record, so that half of the branch is unreachable from this check's own call site.

findings.rule: coding-standards rule 2 (match the surrounding structure; a rename/move of assertions is not a side effect of an unrelated change) — already flagged and accepted as a non-Important nit by this change's own phase (d) adversarial review, re-confirmed independently here; no coverage is actually lost.
findings.summary: Three assertions that belong to test_review_md_structure (the .claude/** / test-lock / plan.md conformance checks) were moved into the newly added test_review_md_skip_marker_rule_present instead of staying in their own function, so the comment at the bottom of the old function ('# rules added by the guide...') now sits under an unrelated test name.
